description: Congenitally missing or previously extracted permanent teeth visible in the panoramic radiograph.
Prosthetic dental crowns (full-coverage restorations) placed on individual teeth.
Endodontically treated teeth exhibiting radiopaque root-canal filling material.
Carious lesions presenting as radiolucent areas in enamel and/or dentin.
Teeth with extensive structural loss (large cavities, fractures, coronal destruction) not restorable with simple restorations.
Third molars (wisdom teeth), regardless of eruption status.
Panoramic radiographs showing normal dental structures without evident caries, missing teeth, root-canal treatment, crowns, fractures, or other significant dental abnormalities.
